Bath Rugby Foundation|work=bathrugbyfoundation.com|accessdate=7 May 2015|archive-date=5 February 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150205205625/http://bathrugbyfoundation.com/about-us/meet-the-team/trustees/|url-status=dead}} He is also the current Chairman of [[Bath City F.C.|Bath City]].{{Cite web |title=Information |url=https://www.bathcityfc.com/information/ |access-date=2022-10-02 |website=Bath City FC |language=en-GB}}{{Cite web |last=Moorcraft |first=Bethan |date=2017-05-04 |title=Bath City FC is now officially owned by the community |url=http://www.bathchronicle.co.uk/sport/football/bath-city-football-club-completes-51758 |access-date=2022-10-02 |website=bathchronicle |language=en}} == Biography == Nicholas Blofeld was born in 1963England & Wales, Birth Index, 1916-2005 and educated at [[Bedford Modern School]] where he was head boy and Captain of the [[Rugby union|Rugby]] first XV.School of the Black & Red, A History of [[Bedford Modern School]], A.G. Underwood (1981); updated 2010 He graduated from [[Loughborough University]] in 1995{{cite web|url=http://www.bathchronicle.co.uk/New-chief-executive-Bath-Rugby/story-11317370-detail/story.html|title=Nick Blofeld appointed Bath Rugby chief executive - Bath Chronicle|work=Bath Chronicle|accessdate=7 May 2015}}{{Dead link|date=December 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }} and then joined the army on a short service commission based in [[Hong Kong]], [[Zimbabwe]] and [[Brunei]]. During his time in Hong Kong he also played for their national sevens side. Blofeld became Chief Executive of Bath Rugby in 2009 after five years at [[Epsom Downs Racecourse]] where he was managing director. In September 2014 he became Group Chief Operating Officer of Bath Rugby, Farleigh Properties Ltd and Arena 1865 (owner of Bath's [[Recreation Ground (Bath)|Rec]]).{{cite web|url=http://www.bathrugby.com/news/club-news/bath-rugby-announce-new-managing-director|title=Bath Rugby announce new Managing Director|work=Bath Rugby|accessdate=7 May 2015}} He is a trustee of the Bath Rugby Foundation. ==References== {{reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Blofeld, Nick}} [[Category:1963 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Sports businesspeople]] [[Category:British businesspeople]] [[Category:Bath Rugby]] [[Category:Alumni of Loughborough University]] [[Category:People educated at Bedford Modern School]]
extract: Nick Blofeld (born 1963) was managing director of Epsom Downs Racecourse between 2007 and 2009, Chief Executive of Bath Rugby between 2009 and 2014 and is currently Group Chief Operations Officer of Bath Rugby and its associated companies, Farleigh Properties Limited and Arena 365 Limited (owner of Bath's Rec). He is a trustee of the Bath Rugby Foundation. He is also the current Chairman of Bath City.
